title: Cross-company connection & visibility
description: Connect with your customers and suppliers directly on Clarity QMS. With mutual agreement, share real-time progress on a specific order — automated notifications as each stage completes, full transparency without a single phone call.

title: Mobile operation sign-off
description: Operators complete and sign off production steps straight from their phone or tablet on the shop floor — no paperwork, no re-keying, records straight into the system as the work happens.

title: Customer OTD & delivered quality dashboard
description: Automatic on-time delivery and product quality metrics, calculated straight from your own despatch and returns data — no spreadsheets required.
